title: Am I Ready for Sex?
aliases: first time er age ki jante hobe
summary: Being ready for sex means you want it for yourself (not to please or keep someone), feel able to say no, understand the risks and have a plan for protection.
key_points: Pressure, fear of losing someone or 'everyone's doing it' are signs to wait.
You can be ready for some things and not others.
